text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... It's just a slight headache. This 
much is no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When times are tough, that's the time to 
dance! A simple headache won't... defeat 
m—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, I'll just dance to 
the rhythm of this headache!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl ended up plagued by a 
headache for a while.
